svg.title: STFT heatmap schematic
svg.desc: Viridis-like STFT power matrix across time windows and period bins, with a mid-window energy change and a short last remainder column.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Rows = period bins. Columns = time windows. Brighter = more power (capped matrix).
